policy: Append-only across phases. Open items are honest limits, never hidden failures.

items.title: Unix socket path length constrained test dirs
items.detail: macOS limits unix socket paths to ~104 bytes (SUN_LEN); the first adversarial-test temp dir name exceeded it and binds failed with InvalidInput.
items.resolution: Test helper switched to short 'axt-<tag>-<pid>' directory names; production socket path is well under the limit.

items.title: macOS peer-credential authentication depth deferred
items.detail: SO_PEERCRED does not exist on macOS; Phase 26 ships the 0700-dir + 0600-socket boundary as the auth contract and defers deeper verification.

items.title: Windows freeze scan needed an explicit allowlist
items.detail: The cfg(windows) freeze gate scans every .rs file outside explicitly allowed prefixes; the initial threshold was miscalibrated for this workspace's file distribution and was set from the measured count (176 files scanned) rather than an invented number.
